name: fastly-real-time-api-to-prometheus
description: Call the listner to call the Fastly Real Time API and transform the result into a Prometheus counters and histogram format
author: Edouard Berteloot

scripts.test: cross-env FRTATP_FASTLY_KEY=fake FRTATP_LOGS_DIR=/tmp FRTATP_BYPASS_INITIAL_TEST=true FRTATP_LOGS_CONSOLE=true FRTATP_VERBOSE=true FRTATP_MISS_LATENCY_PERCENTILES=10,50 FRTATP_BACKGROUND_EXECUTION_PERIOD=0 NODE_ENV=test mocha
